verdict.rationale: Calendly ships a built-in AI assistant, Callie. You can add it to an email thread to coordinate scheduling on your behalf, chat with it via 'Ask Callie', and use a meeting-work assistant alongside the Notetaker's recaps and action items. That is genuine in-product task delegation, though it is labeled Beta and evidenced only by marketing and pricing copy. The MCP server is an external integration and was not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on what tasks Callie can do and its limits, non-beta status, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the delegation works.
